purpose: Evidence eligibility audit; no model-score comparison in this audit
primary_rule: Author-supplied Table 2 sequence mutations in at least 3 distinct patients, within IMPACT341 consistently assayed panel; uniquely mapped to frozen gene universe; exclude all 17 existing positives
secondary: All author-supplied alteration types and one-patient sequence evidence, reported separately; no merging mouse and human labels
threshold_rationale: Three-patient recurrence follows the study gene-level enrichment eligibility threshold; not optimized against model performance
independence: MSK collection is institutionally distinct from consumed TCGA/CPTAC/ICGC cohorts, but cross-study donor identity is not established. Knowledge-base ascertainment is not biologically independent. Genes were previously present as unlabelled training data; this is not an unseen-gene benchmark.
model_policy: No models retrained, no scores evaluated, no training labels changed; freeze a separate evaluation protocol after eligibility and provenance review
mouse_status: Publisher supplements HTTP403; PMC served verification HTML; Europe PMC supplementary API reports unavailable. No validated mouse gene table or orthology mapping obtained.
